title: AGENTS.md
text: Use age terminology prefix public functions age_. Keep recipient passphrase APIs separate functions. Raw APIs return raw vectors, including armored ciphertext. File APIs stream native file descriptors; load whole files R vectors. Every native entry point returns (status, payload). C must clean return error suffix; must call Rf_error() mid-operation. Keep native error suffixes aligned age_error_* R condition classes. backend reentrant. Run R’s main thread, one operation time. Keep identity secrets opaque, scrubbed native allocations. print, coerce, expose secret bytes. Never silently overwrite files remove input/output collision checks. Use operating-system CSPRNGs . Compiled code must call exit() abort() write standard streams. reference age rage CLI test oracle, never runtime backend.

what: How it works, and why you can trust it
title: File Encryption with the age Format
text: Spec-compliant. Passes official C2SP CCTV age test vectors (X25519 scrypt) — known answers decrypt correctly malformed inputs rejected. Interoperable. Reference age CLI fixtures exercised test suite, reverse interoperability checked fixtures generated. Self-contained. ChaCha20-Poly1305, X25519, HKDF, scrypt SHA-256 vendored; OS-specific code random-bytes call (getentropy / arc4random_buf / BCryptGenRandom). Careful secrets. identity’s secret bytes held C behind opaque pointer, zeroed finalizer, never printed returned R age_identity object. Secrets passphrases pass strings, read key file, necessarily live R normal lifetime — package () hide .

title: File Encryption with the age Format
text: Supported: X25519 recipients, scrypt passphrases, ASCII armor — full age v1 format common cases. currently supported: SSH-key recipients (ssh-ed25519 …), plugin / hardware / post-quantum recipients. require new stanza types C backend rather R glue. Concurrency: encryption decryption must run R’s main thread, one operation time — usual way R calls compiled code. C backend keeps process-global state, functions reentrant must called multiple threads parallel (e.g. threaded worker pool). Normal sequential use unaffected.

text: x age_encrypt_raw_passphrase(), raw vector plaintext. age_decrypt_raw_passphrase(), raw vector ciphertext length-1 armored string. passphrase length-1 character string. NULL (default) session interactive, prompted securely via askpass::askpass() (suggested askpass package must installed). Avoid hard-coding passphrases scripts. armor TRUE, produce ASCII-armored output. log_n scrypt work factor, base-2 logarithm parameter N. Higher slower brute-force resistant. Defaults 18; values 22 rejected (also decrypt) bound work. input, output File paths. output = NULL appends/strips .age age_encrypt_file(). overwrite FALSE (default), error output already exists.
